lessons_used: Home new flow changes have proven helpful, winning 2 out of 3 tests.
Finish hint changes showed no clear effect across all 4 tests.
Adoption redesign changes showed no clear effect or performed worse across 2 tests.
Predictions were consistently too high across all round 1 tests.

Evidence is still thin for adoption incentive, adoption layout, choose_path copy, choose_path layout, choose_path redesign, home redesign, home wait_info, sign_in copy, sign_in redesign, and sign_in reorder changes as they lack at least two agreeing tests.

candidates.title: Interactive desktop pet loading status flow
candidates.change: Replaces the waiting screen status panel with a multi-phase live progress flow showing pet asset creation milestones, pet personality initialization, and desktop readiness alerts.
candidates.why: Home conversion step waiting screen has a very high mean duration (2336s) and high drop-off; earlier tests showed home new flows are effective.

wait_status.text: Your pet companion is coming to life on your desktop!

guard.reason: replacement for 'waiting.wait_status' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['preview', 'progress', 'timer']

candidates.title: Spotlight layout redesign for final welcome screen
candidates.change: Redesigns the home intro screen into a spotlight layout featuring an animated pet greeting card and prominent completion action.
candidates.why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8% and support reported confusion on pet behavior immediately following onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Meet Your Desktop Companion!
home_intro.body: Your companion is now active on your desktop. Click and drag or right-click anytime to interact.

guard.reason: Redesigns the home intro screen within onboarding bounds without altering functionality.

candidates.score_note: Finish step drop-off is high, but redesigns and finish tweaks have poor track record.

candidates.title: Pet preview style selection new screen in adoption
candidates.change: Inserts a new companion preview screen before certification where users can preview their chosen pet's default idle animation style.
candidates.why: Adoption has a steep drop-off (60.9%) and support emails noted custom pet generation errors or unexpected appearances.

new_pet_style_preview.headline: Preview Companion Style
new_pet_style_preview.body: See how your desktop pet will look and move on your screen.

guard.reason: Adds a valid preview screen within the onboarding flow without removing any required steps.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has biggest drop-off and support tickets, but adding screens increases friction.

candidates.title: Card layout security redesign for sign-in screen
candidates.change: Redesigns the sign-in screen with a card layout that includes a cloud sync badge and account safety indicators.
candidates.why: Top support theme (8 emails) involved missing or reset pets after signing back in, showing account cloud save confusion.

sign_in.headline: Save Your Companion's Progress
sign_in.body: Sign in to keep your pet safely saved to your cloud profile so you never lose progress when logging in from another device.

guard.reason: Redesigns the sign-in screen card layout while retaining its core function.

candidates.score_note: Addresses major support complaints, though full redesign requires new build.

candidates.title: Carousel pet browsing layout for friend selection
candidates.change: Changes the pick_friend screen layout to a carousel view with clear pet personality labels.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel (60.9%) and high median time (89s).

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Desktop Friend
pick_friend.body: Swipe or click to view available desktop pet companions.

guard.reason: Updates the pick_friend layout to a carousel while keeping the pet selection job intact.

candidates.score_note: Targets lowest funnel step; layout tweaks previously yielded mild positive results.

candidates.title: Sign-in cloud save account protection copy
candidates.change: Updates sign-in headline and body copy to emphasize account restoration and cloud pet retention.
candidates.why: Eight support tickets last week specifically mentioned pets missing or resetting upon re-authentication.

sign_in.headline: Protect Your Pet With Cloud Restore
sign_in.body: Connecting your account ensures your pet's memory, items, and settings remain safe whenever you log back in.

guard.reason: Updates sign-in copy to emphasize cloud backup without violating any base rules.

candidates.score_note: Easy copy change matching support issues, but sign_in copy previously underperformed.

candidates.title: Desktop readiness sound and alert notification
candidates.change: Adds ready notification sound and toggle components to the waiting screen when pet generation finishes.
candidates.why: Users spend long mean durations (2336s) waiting for background asset creation; audio alerts bring them back instantly.

components.text: We will chime when your pet is live on your desktop!

guard.reason: Adds notification sounds and readiness text to the waiting screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Solves extreme wait durations on Home flow, aligned with positive home flow changes.

candidates.title: Waiting screen live estimated completion timer
candidates.change: Enables the show_time_estimate indicator and adds a countdown timer component to the waiting screen.
candidates.why: High waiting screen mean time (2336s) causes drop-offs without clear time expectation.

guard.reason: Adds an estimated completion timer for a real wait period, which is explicitly permitted under Rule 5.

candidates.score_note: Config toggle setting clear expectation for long Home step duration.

candidates.title: Path selection recommendation incentive badge
candidates.change: Adds a high-visibility badge component emphasizing recommended quick setup paths on the choose_path screen.
candidates.why: Choose path screen shows high mean time (514s), indicating hesitation during path selection.

guard.reason: Creates urgency or pressure by framing adoption with a time limit

candidates.title: Story screen interactive introduction sub-flow
candidates.change: Replaces the default intro story block with a playful interactive animation and animated mascot intro before path selection.
candidates.why: Improves early engagement before choose_path screen where users spend a mean of 514s.

intro_story.text: Welcome to your new desktop world! Let's find your perfect companion.

guard.reason: replacement for 'story.intro_story' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'mascot', 'video'] with an asset:story/ asset
